_comment: Phase 5 C1: the four kinds of job a contract can be (docs/plans/phase5_contracts.md C1, director Q-9). The board draws one per posted contract on the Rng 'jobs' stream (sim/economy/contract_book.gd); sim/world/jobs.gd places the party and judges done or failed. 'party' is the WorldParty type the job puts on the map (its walking numbers are in data/balance/world.json 'parties', its line-ups in data/encounters.json); 'words' is the job's name in data/text/en.json. Schema: data/schema/jobs.schema.json.
